verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents claiming additional sandboxes from a snapshot for parallel tasks, so it supports concurrent sandboxes to a basic degree. The only capacity-related statement is that resume "requires available capacity". Nothing documents fleet scale or any concurrency limits. Missing for 10: documented concurrency/quota limits, evidence of large-fleet scale, fleet orchestration or performance benchmarks, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits

citations.quote: Claim additional sandboxes with that snapshot ID for parallel tasks.
resume takes time and requires available capacity
